title: What to pick at Chinese restaurants and chap fan shops when you want to lose weight
intro: Chap fan or Chinese mixed rice shops are practical for a working lunch. There are many steamed dishes and stir-fried vegetables that suit you. What you need to watch out for are fried dishes, sweet sauces and flooded gravy. The calorie numbers below are estimates.

best.name: White rice, half plate
best.why: Still eating rice, just a more controlled portion. Enough energy for afternoon work.

best.name: Steamed fish with ginger or soy sauce (1 portion)
best.why: High protein, little oil. One of the best choices at a chap fan shop.

best.name: Steamed egg (1 portion)
best.why: Soft, light and cheap. Good extra protein.

best.name: Sawi or choy sum stir-fried with garlic (1 big scoop)
best.why: Take two types of vegetables. Full plate, calories stay low.

best.name: Steamed tofu or tofu in oyster sauce (2 pieces)
best.why: Protein from soybeans. Pick the ones that aren't deep-fried.

best.name: Radish soup or vegetable soup (1 bowl)
best.why: Clear soup makes you fuller without many calories.

careful.name: Sweet and sour chicken (1 scoop)
careful.why: Chicken is battered, fried and coated in sugary sauce. Take just 2-3 pieces.

careful.name: Butter prawns or fried battered prawns (1 scoop)
careful.why: Butter, batter and oil. Nice once in a while, not every day.

careful.name: Fu yong egg (1 piece)
careful.why: Egg fried in a lot of oil. Steamed egg is lighter.

careful.name: Crispy fried tofu (3 pieces)
careful.why: Tofu soaks up oil when fried. Choose the steamed or sauce version.

careful.name: Curry gravy flooded over rice
careful.why: Santan gravy adds calories without you noticing. Ask for gravy on the side or just a little.

hacks: Easy formula: 1 steamed protein, 2 vegetables, half plate of rice.
Ask for 'kuah sikit' (less gravy) or 'kuah asing' (gravy on the side), don't flood your rice.
Take vegetables a bit drier and leave the oil in the tray first.
Pick dishes labelled 'steamed', 'boiled' or 'stir-fried' over 'fried' and 'sweet and sour'.
If there's a fried dish you're craving, take just one and balance it with vegetables.
drink: Hot Chinese tea without sugar or plain water. If you want something cold, ask for teh O ais kosong (iced black tea, no sugar).

faq.q: Is white rice or brown rice better?
faq.a: Both are fine. Brown rice has more fibre and is more filling. But if the shop only has white rice, controlling your portion is enough.

faq.q: If I have chap fan for lunch every day, won't it get boring?
faq.a: Switch up your protein: steamed fish today, chicken tomorrow, tofu and egg the day after. Pick different vegetables too. With the same formula, you still get lots of variety.
